sources: manual reading of Chapter07's Java sources, application.yml files and docker-compose*.yml at the pinned commit; paths are relative to Chapter07
notes: One send site serves all three bindings: the literal binding names are arguments of the private helper sendMessage. Each compose file (RabbitMQ by default, Kafka in docker-compose-kafka.yml) deploys the same three links. The auditGroup producer group has no consumer in the repository.

links.evidence: sendMessage("products-out-0", ...) at lines 83, 99 calls streamBridge.send(bindingName, message); products-out-0.destination is products in microservices/product-composite-service/src/main/resources/application.yml; the @Bean Consumer messageProcessor is the function definition of product, bound as messageProcessor-in-0 with destination products in microservices/product-service/src/main/resources/application.yml

sendMessage("recommendations-out-0", ...) at lines 107, 126 calls streamBridge.send(bindingName, message); recommendations-out-0.destination is recommendations in microservices/product-composite-service/src/main/resources/application.yml; the @Bean Consumer messageProcessor is the function definition of recommendation, bound as messageProcessor-in-0 with destination recommendations in microservices/recommendation-service/src/main/resources/application.yml

sendMessage("reviews-out-0", ...) at lines 134, 153 calls streamBridge.send(bindingName, message); reviews-out-0.destination is reviews in microservices/product-composite-service/src/main/resources/application.yml; the @Bean Consumer messageProcessor is the function definition of review, bound as messageProcessor-in-0 with destination reviews in microservices/review-service/src/main/resources/application.yml
